title: Qt: Lua Debugger: Show yellow arrow on paused line in gutter
description:
Draw a yellow right-pointing triangle in the line-number gutter on
the line the debugger is currently paused at. When a breakpoint sits
on the same line, the existing red circle is rendered dimmed and the
triangle is overlaid on top, so both indicators are visible but the
paused-line arrow dominates.

AI-Assisted: yes
